title: Discrete Choice vs. Rating Scale Decision Elicitation
thumbnail_alt: Discrete choice vs rating scale experiment screenshot
summary: The first direct empirical test of whether discrete choice and rating scale tasks tap the same internal representation. Bayesian model comparison favours a shared latent representation for 71% of participants — but choice tasks produce more widely separated latent states, making them a more sensitive measurement instrument. The remaining 29% of participants show evidence of genuinely distinct representations across formats.
